task: Issue #225: reusable RPY hydrodynamics archive and fixed-camera flow overlay
summary: Opt-in hydro_archive stores 1 ms-cadence bead positions and total forces for compact RPY runs.
Post-processing reconstructs self/other/source velocity contributions and RPY velocity at arbitrary spatial points without storing mobility matrices or flow grids.
The replay entry point renders a 3x3x3 vector overlay with follow_camera_3d forced to false.
